UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue 
SET status = 'pending', batch_id = NULL
WHERE status = 'processing'
  AND recipient_type = 'personal'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '12 minutes';

WITH new_batch AS (
    SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id
),
updated_rows AS (
    UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue 
    SET status = 'processing', batch_id = (SELECT id FROM new_batch)
    WHERE status = 'pending'
      AND recipient_type = 'personal'
    RETURNING batch_id
)
SELECT batch_id FROM updated_rows LIMIT 1;

values.content:
=Kamu adalah asisten peringatan dini banjir ALERA FI. Kirim pesan via Telegram DM ke satu warga per rumah tangga. Tulis seperti bot yang dipersonalisasi — bukan notifikasi generik, Dituliskan dalam bentuk paragraf naratif beserta poin poin.

DATA:
- Profil risiko: {{ $json.risk_profile }}
- Jarak ke sungai: {{ $json.distance_to_river_m }} m
- Cuaca satelit: {{ $json.weather_info }}
- Sensor: {{ JSON.stringify($json.processed_sensors) }}

ATURAN:
- Bahasa Indonesia saja.
- Hanya gunakan data di atas. Jangan karang angka, cuaca, jarak, atau nama pos.
- Nada: level naik → tegas & darurat; level turun/Normal → menenangkan tapi tetap waspada.
- Sensor rf + wl → gabung dalam 1 pesan koheren.
- Tidak ada sub-judul, salam pembuka, atau kata "AI/model/sistem otomatis/JSON".
- Format Markdown (bold, newline). Bold HANYA untuk urgensi. Gunakan emoji sebagai penanda visual.
- Maks ~300 kata.

LEVEL:
0 = Normal
1 = Siaga 3 — Waspada
2 = Siaga 2 — Bersiap
3 = Siaga 1 — Darurat

OUTPUT:

🚨 *ALERA FI : FEWS* 🚨

Tulis 2–3 kalimat naratif:
→ Dampak perubahan level sensor & artinya bagi rumah ini
→ Tindakan konkret sekarang sesuai level, jarak, & profil risiko:
  • [tindakan 1]
  • [tindakan 2: amankan dokumen, listrik, barang berharga]
  • [tindakan 3: evakuasi jika diperlukan]

Tulis 2 kalimat naratif:
→ Kondisi cuaca terkini dari data satelit
→ Kondisi pos pantau sungai dikaitkan dengan jarak rumah ke sungai

Tulis narasi potensi bahaya, lalu poin:
  • Perubahan status pos pantau beserta tren level-nya
  • Posisi elevasi: diff >50m → pos di hulu (risiko kiriman air); diff <50m → pos di hilir/setara (risiko genangan lokal)
  • Jarak ke pos pantau dalam km — jika dekat (<5 km) sebutkan potensi dampak lebih cepat sampai; jika jauh (>5 km) sebutkan masih ada waktu untuk bersiap

Tulis 1 kalimat realistis (menenangkan jika level turun; tegas jika tinggi), diikuti:
  • 🕐 Waktu pengukuran: [ISO Z + 7 jam → WIB]
  • 📍 Pos pantau: [nama pos yang berubah]

-- 1. Bersihkan status antrean menjadi selesai
UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue 
SET status = 'sent'
WHERE id IN ({{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.queue_ids.map(id => "'" + id + "'").join(',') }});

-- 2. Tulis jejak pengiriman ke riwayat log
INSERT INTO public.notification_log (user_id, sensor_id, warning_level, message_text, channel)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.user_id }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript1').item.json.processed_sensors[0].sensor_id }}',
  {{ $('Code in JavaScript1').item.json.processed_sensors[0].current_warning_level }},
  '{{ $json.result.text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'telegram_dm'::text
);

UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue
SET status = 'pending', batch_id = NULL
WHERE status = 'processing'
  AND recipient_type = 'community'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '12 minutes';

WITH new_batch AS (
    SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id
),
updated_rows AS (
    UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue q
    SET status = 'processing',
        batch_id = (SELECT id FROM new_batch)
    FROM public.community_profiles cp
    WHERE cp.user_id = q.user_id
      AND q.status = 'pending'
      AND q.recipient_type = 'community'
      AND cp.telegram_group_id IS NOT NULL
      AND cp.auto_alert_enabled = true
    RETURNING q.batch_id
)
SELECT batch_id FROM updated_rows LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  q.id AS queue_id,
  q.user_id AS community_id,
  q.sensor_id,
  q.old_level,
  q.new_level,
  q.value,
  q.trend_3h,
  q.measured_at,
  q.batch_id,
  q.status AS queue_status,

  cp.community_name,
  cp.telegram_group_id AS destination_chat_id,
  cp.telegram_group_title,
  cp.auto_alert_enabled,

  im.pos_name,
  im.sensor_type
FROM public.ews_alert_queue q
JOIN public.community_profiles cp ON cp.user_id = q.user_id
JOIN public.instrument_metadata im ON im.sensor_id = q.sensor_id
WHERE q.status = 'processing'
  AND q.recipient_type = 'community'
  AND q.batch_id = '{{ $json.batch_id || "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" }}'::uuid
  AND cp.telegram_group_id IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.auto_alert_enabled = true;

UPDATE public.ews_alert_queue
SET status = 'sent'
WHERE id IN ({{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.queue_ids.map(id => "'" + id + "'").join(',') }});

INSERT INTO public.notification_log (user_id, sensor_id, warning_level, message_text, channel)
SELECT
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.community_id }}'::uuid,
  sensor.sensor_id,
  sensor.new_level::integer,
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.telegram_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'telegram_channel'::text
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($('Code in JavaScript3').item.json.sensors).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb)
AS sensor(sensor_id text, new_level integer);
